svg.title: Raw recording stacks across three modalities
svg.desc: Six stacked Neuropixels probe heatmaps, two stacks containing eight mesoscope plane images, and two SLAP2 plane images merging green iGluSnFR4f with red RCaMP3 show the native raw-data formats.

g.text: 6 probe recordings · all raw excerpts stacked
